_comment: Known failures of the credential leak test list (secret_corpus.jsonl) on main, per connector and per case. A listed (connector, case) is reported, not failed; any other gated failure fails CI and names the case, the form and the sink. This file only SHRINKS: an entry may be removed at any time, and may be added only for a case id that does not exist in the merge base's secret_corpus.jsonl (a newly learned case lands with the connectors it already fails on). A connector that has adopted the shared credential kit (cli/internal/credkit/) has no entries. class_secret_corpus.py --update-baseline retires entries that now pass; ci_guards.sh runs --check-baseline against the merge base.
